subject: Keeping the pilot live while procurement clears
messages:
From: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@helixhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Kim <laura.kim@helixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access — procurement delay, can you keep the sandbox live?

Hi Irene / Marissa,

Quick note from our side — procurement has the PO and security paperwork in flight but the vendor onboarding team flagged one last evidence item that won't clear until early next week (they estimated Tue 5/11). Our pilot team is mid-integration and losing access would break demos to two key stakeholders next week.

Is there any way Redwood can keep our sandbox active or extend the trial window for ~10–14 days while procurement finishes? We can provide the PO number and an internal attestation that the purchase is committed. If it's helpful, cc'd Laura is handling procurement on our side.

Thanks for any help — we want to keep momentum.

—Sam
Sam Peterson
Head of Data & AI, Helix Health
Phone: +1 415-555-0192
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement delay, can you keep the sandbox live?

Hi Sam — thanks for the context and for looping Laura in. Appreciate the heads-up.

We can absolutely help preserve the pilot while procurement wraps up. To move quickly I can provision a provisional credit to cover expected usage for a short runway. Two quick questions so we size this appropriately:
- What peak concurrency / daily token volume are you seeing in the pilot (ballpark)?
- Do you expect any heavy eval runs (batch embeddings / long prompts) in the next 10 days?

If you prefer, we can start with a conservative 50k-token top-up for 7 days and escalate to a 14-day 100k token bump if finance signs off. I’ll loop in our finance ops (cc'd internally) to approve the 14-day scenario — if they sign off we’ll provision it and send a short confirmation with a DocuSign reference for the forthcoming PO.

Please reply with the ballpark usage and I’ll take care of the rest.

Best,
Irene Choi
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Approval request — Helix Health provisional trial credit

Team,

Quick internal: Helix Health (Sam + Laura) asked to keep their pilot live while procurement finishes. They say PO is in flight and security evidence will clear next week (estimated Tue 5/11).

I recommend we provision a provisional 50k-token credit for 7 days immediately to avoid demo disruption. If finance is comfortable, approve expanding to a 14-day 100k-token credit contingent on receipt of PO/PO number within the next week. Rationale: enterprise sales momentum (two exec demos next week), onboarding close timeline, and committed buyer.

Can Ben/Neha confirm finance/legal appetite? If approved I’ll notify the customer and include the DocuSign reference.

Thanks — Irene
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Approval request — Helix Health provisional trial credit

Irene / team,

Approve the provisional credit under these conditions:
1) Grant 100k-token credit for up to 14 days (effective immediately).
2) Customer must provide PO number and expected invoice date within 7 business days.
3) Finance will flag the account for follow-up; if PO does not arrive within 10 business days we will reverse unused credits per our standard policy.

I’ve attached a short finance approval memo for the record.

Attachment: finance-approval.pdf (approval memo, finance note)

Ben Carter
Senior Finance Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Peterson <sam.peterson@helixhealth.com>, Laura Kim <laura.kim@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot access — procurement delay, can you keep the sandbox live?

Hi Sam / Laura — good news. Finance approved a provisional 100k-token credit for up to 14 days while procurement completes. Details below: 

- Provisioned credit: 100,000 tokens
- Validity window: 2027-05-05 09:00 PDT through 2027-05-19 09:00 PDT
- Conditions: Please provide PO number within 7 business days and expected invoice date. If the PO is not received we will follow up and may reverse unused tokens per finance policy.

We’ve also attached a short note for your records. You’ll receive a DocuSign when finance receives the PO to tie the trial increment to the forthcoming invoice.

Attachment: trial-credit-note.txt (provisional credit details)

If you want me to bump concurrency limits or whitelist any IPs for integration runs, let me know and we’ll make it happen.

Best,
Irene
